note: Candidates are not reviewers who agreed to participate. Contacts and services are grounded on official pages; program eligibility and prices require direct confirmation. No inquiry submitted.

candidates.organization: The Ohio State University — CETE Assessment Program
candidates.fit: Explicit support for non-accreditation assessment item writing, test revision, validity evidence and psychometrics; most relevant preliminary inquiry for small public instrument.
candidates.contact_method: Official CETE general contact email / project contact listed on service page
candidates.scope_to_verify: Will CETE consider a small, independent, public, non-commercial 12-item constructed-response educational research instrument? Are low/no-cost preliminary feedback, referrals or a limited fixed-scope quote possible?
candidates.eligibility: open-client language for clients not seeking accreditation, but individual startup projects not guaranteed

candidates.organization: Buros Center for Testing — Psychometric Consulting
candidates.fit: Consultation/independent evaluation and measurement expertise. Important: standard Mental Measurements Yearbook review explicitly excludes research/public-domain instruments; enquire about separate consulting only.
candidates.contact_method: Psychometric Consulting contact on official site
candidates.scope_to_verify: Can the separate consulting unit assess a small public-domain pilot instrument's content validity and scoring rubric? Do NOT request a standard Mental Measurements Yearbook test review. Ask minimum scope, price and referrals.
candidates.eligibility: research/public-domain excluded from standard published test reviews, consulting acceptance not established

candidates.fit: Public services include performance assessment design and comparing assessment meaning over time; mostly works with states/districts. Small independent owner-run project fit uncertain.
candidates.contact_method: Official contact form (asks for user identity/contact information)
candidates.scope_to_verify: Ask whether independent rubric/item review for an early-stage non-school public pilot is in scope and whether a referral or low-cost educational consultation exists.
candidates.eligibility: primarily states, school districts and education-system clients; individual instrument inquiry may be declined

resource_only.name: National Council on Measurement in Education (NCME) Ph.D. program/faculty directory
resource_only.purpose: Potential academic faculty expertise discovery or later referral, NOT a review service or promise of availability.

excluded_shortcuts.name: Buros Mental Measurements Yearbook (MMY)
excluded_shortcuts.reason: Its official FAQ excludes public-domain/research instruments from standard published test-review process. A separate consultant may still be asked.

excluded_shortcuts.name: University of Michigan CRLT individual consultation
excluded_shortcuts.reason: Published consultations are for University of Michigan Ann Arbor affiliates, not automatically open to outside project owners.

excluded_shortcuts.name: Michigan State CTLI consultation
excluded_shortcuts.reason: Published service supports MSU educators; no outside access confirmed.

permission_boundary: PCA-003: any actual outbound requests, DMs, web form submissions or expenses require separate explicit owner authorization and scope. Merely publishing this shortlist is not outreach.
